tasks.instructions: Write the Staging transform collection, the four staging transforms (stg_pull_requests, stg_commits, stg_pr_review_comments, stg_issues) writing schema staging in the github Database, the github_activity transform tag and the GitHub activity daily job. Each transform keeps the raw grain (number, sha, id), renames columns per c01's approach and derives is_bot once (user_type = 'Bot' or login ending '[bot]'; commits by author_login only). stg_issues drops rows where is_pull_request is true; stg_pr_review_comments parses pull_request_number from pull_request_url. List every column, no SELECT *. Follow the build-clean-tables playbook.
